scope: Approved DAC and matrix repairs; only leaves 1800,2200,2600,3100 modified; no global library changes or reference renumbering.

intentional_net_changes.reason: Existing 10k pulldown follows the intentionally changed U3103 inverter input; gate clamp is qualified per pulse.

intentional_component_value_changes.reason: U3102 supply raised from ANA5 to P15; keep 100nF and use adequate voltage rating.

removed_instances.reason: Wrong orphan OPA4192 power unit replaced by actual OPA192 supply unit
Ground marker for formerly unused U2603C removed
Ground marker for formerly unused U2604D removed

preserved_values: All DAC gain straps, DAC and amplifier IC models

operating_contract.write_sources: 0...+10 V only; AD5761R forming range configured unipolar 0...10 V with overrange disabled.
operating_contract.dut_sign: Select with MAT_POLARITY; the current-return sink always receives positive current.
operating_contract.unsupported: Negative absolute MAT_SOURCE/VFORM_SRC is not supported by the single-sided 2N7002 current sink; body diode bypasses control.
operating_contract.tracking_off: MAT_WRITE_PULSE=0: U2603C selects OUT as feedback; U2604D isolates amplifier from gate; Q3102 plus R3104 hold gate low.
operating_contract.tracking_on: MAT_WRITE_PULSE=1: U2603C selects raw CC_SENSE; U2604D connects amplifier through R3103 to gate; clamp releases.
operating_contract.not_yet_proven: Loop phase margin, switching transient and first-pulse overshoot require simulation and later bench checks; 100pF is the initial compensation, not a certified stability result.
operating_contract.power_sequence: Ordinary ADG54xx are not power-off protected. Analog sources and 3.3V controls must respect actual switch rails during sequencing.

no_gate_source_resistor_reason: R3104 already supplies passive gate-to-GND off state. Adding a gate-to-sense resistor injects gate current into the sensitive shunt node and changes microamp current calibration.

native_validation.visual_review: Four native-exported schematic pages rendered and inspected; new circuits/labels/captions remain inside page frames without collisions.

editorial_update: Five Russian paragraphs per affected sheet and matching English inline descriptions updated; no electrical edits in this pass.

dnp_operating_note: BL/NL and MAT_RETURN optional bleed footprints remain, unpopulated. With all switches off these nodes may float; use existing BL_ZERO/NL_ZERO clamps and a deliberate discharge interval when permitted by the DUT. Do not treat DNP parts as default DC paths.
explanation_update_after_DNP: Added leaf2700, corrected floating OFF nodes and clarified DUT-current vs MOS-current after removing bypass bleeders.

dynamic_validation.status: BLOCKING: current-compliance stage not approved for PCB release as a fast microamp pulse limiter
dynamic_validation.preserved_compensation: C3104=100pF, R3103=100 Ohm. No unvalidated passive replacement applied.
dynamic_validation.topological_limitation: Low-side sense does not measure current charging external return-to-GND capacitance through the DUT. Removing DC bleeders does not remove this capacitive path.
dynamic_validation.numerical_scope: Unchanged official TI OPA197 macromodel in ngspice ps mode; approximate MOSFET/switch/parasitic representations. Results are counterexamples and sensitivity checks, not guaranteed hardware limits.
